# CrsfSensor:popFrame

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.6.0</span></div>

Pop a CRSF frame.

```lua
local command = sensor:popFrame([commandFilterMin[, commandFilterMax]])
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `commandFilterMin` | integer | optional |  |
| `commandFilterMax` | integer | optional |  |

## Returns

command (integer), data (table)

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
local sensor = crsf.getSensor()
local command, data = sensor:popFrame() -- all frames
local command, data = sensor:popFrame(0x10) -- VTX frames
local command, data = sensor:popFrame(0x7A, 0x7B) -- MSP frames
```
